items.name: anthropic-smb-ap-processor
adaptation: Rewrote the main workflow and substantive reference procedures as a faithful self-contained t3OS accounting-preparation adaptation, retaining the source work sequence, essential evidence checks and all bundled reference/shared resource paths.

Removed external bill/vendor creation, approval, sync, posting, payments, message sending, payment-link creation, scheduling and page-publishing instructions throughout the active workflow and references.

Replaced fixed connector recipes and product-wide capability claims with actual-schema checks, source-of-record reconciliation and scoped-export fallback; no connector installation or unbound skill is assumed.
Adapted shared client isolation, completeness, currency, privacy, voice and artifact policies; client-specific context is not written into immutable shared catalog resources.
Mapped skill continuations to actual installed names when available, documented read_skill/read_skill_resource, and normalized resource links to registered skill-root names.
Corrected the illustrative gross-credit-net arithmetic and made unresolved allocations, credits and coding explicit review questions rather than guessed values or automatic netting.

items.name: t3-accounting-engagement
adaptation: Original engagement and evidence contract shared by all five Agency-derived accounting roles.

items.name: Bookkeeper & Controller
adaptation: Rewrote the community persona as a reusable accounting-firm role with supported t3OS capabilities and actual bundled skill keys.
Removed fictional identity, career claims, universal US-law assumptions, invented connector availability and autonomous external execution.
Preserved the role’s substantive work sequence and deliverables as evidence-linked preparation for the engagement’s confirmed framework, jurisdiction and reviewer.
Bound the original t3-accounting-engagement helper and selected official Anthropic finance/small-business adaptations; model, client data and runtime bindings remain deployment configuration.
Kept the Tax Strategist jurisdiction-aware research/preparation rather than claiming a Singapore GST implementation or any preset tax regime.
